title: Build an Accessible Sign‑Up Form
description: Create a registration form with labels, fieldset, and proper structure.
problemStatement:
## Accessible Registration Form

Build an HTML form for user registration with the following fields:

* Full name (text)
* Email (email type)
* Password (password type)
* Favourite colour (radio group: Red, Green, Blue)
* Terms and conditions checkbox
* Submit button

Requirements:
* Every input must have a properly associated label.
* Radio buttons must be inside a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`.
* The submit button must be a `<button>` element, not an input.
* Include a clear and descriptive caption for the form.

No CSS needed – just semantic HTML.
hints: Use `for` and `id` to associate labels with inputs.
Wrap the radio group in `<fieldset>` and add `<legend>`.
Use `type="email"` for email to trigger appropriate virtual keyboard on mobile.
expectedOutput: An HTML form that passes accessibility checks (axe, manual test).
